skills.name: inspect location
skills.guidance:
Use the caller-supplied location.
Navigate when required, open only when authorized, then inspect the location.
Return the declared location after the inspection effect is verified.
Returns the inspected location; public catalog/evidence contains observations. Does not claim a sought object was found.

skills.name: find object in scope
skills.guidance:
Search only the supplied ordered location scope.
Use the current public affordances to identify a matching takeable object and its source.
Return the matched object and source without taking it.
Only publicly takeable matching objects are returned. Exhausted scope fails without a fabricated object.
No dynamic exclusion-list support. Supply an exact eligible target when exclusions matter.

skills.name: acquire known object
skills.guidance:
Use the supplied concrete object and source.
Navigate and perform authorized opening when needed, then take that same object.
Return the verified holding result without selecting a different object.
Concrete object and its known source are caller supplied. An already-satisfied Atomic is handled by the existing runtime effect check.

skills.name: search and acquire
skills.guidance:
Search only the caller-authorized ordered scope.
Select a publicly takeable object matching the supplied target and take it.
Return the concrete held object and the unchanged opening authorization.
Only publicly takeable matching objects are returned. Exhausted scope fails without a fabricated object.
No dynamic exclusion-list support. Supply an exact eligible target when exclusions matter.

skills.name: deliver held object
skills.guidance:
Use the held object and the supplied destination.
Navigate and perform authorized opening when needed, then place the same object.
Return the declared placement result.

skills.name: clean held object
skills.guidance:
Use the held object and supplied cleaning station.
Reach the station and perform the available cleaning operation.
Return the same object with the verified cleaning result.
Uses the Harness macro primitive, not appliance substeps or timers. Stops on terminal interrupt.

skills.name: heat held object
skills.guidance:
Use the held object and supplied heating station.
Reach the station and perform the available heating operation.
Return the same object with the verified heating result.
Uses the Harness macro primitive, not appliance substeps or timers. Stops on terminal interrupt.

skills.name: cool held object
skills.guidance:
Use the held object and supplied cooling station.
Reach the station and perform the available cooling operation.
Return the same object with the verified cooling result.
Uses the Harness macro primitive, not appliance substeps or timers. Stops on terminal interrupt.

skills.name: observe held object with light
skills.guidance:
Use the held object, light and light location supplied by the caller.
Reach the location and perform the supported light operation when the goal is not already satisfied.
Return the verified observation result for that object and light.
Light and its location are explicitly grounded by the caller. No trailing action after a terminal observation.

skeletons.name: Search and acquire, deliver
skeletons.guidance:
Acquire the authorized object and preserve its concrete identity.
Execute each declared processing step before delivery or observation.
Pass outputs only along the declared data-flow edges.
For repeated work, acquire a distinct object for each iteration and preserve the shared destination.
Missing scope, station or source inputs remain for the Agent to ground.
